name: Power Power Supply — I2C, LDO — QFP
description: Surface-mount power supply components featuring I2C communication and LDO functionality in QFP packages such as TQFP-48.
selection_hints: Confirm requirement for integrated I2C interface and LDO support.
Ensure compatibility with the SMD TQFP-48_7x7mm_P0.5mm land pattern.
Verify symbol pin mapping and electrical specifications for the application.
avoid_when: Designs requiring non-QFP packages or through-hole mounting.
Applications that do not need I2C communication or LDO regulation.
A footprint pitch or pin count other than 48-pin 0.5mm pitch is needed.
